_comment: Eval suite 'core' (tools/eval_harness.py). Self-contained, objective checks, no tool use, so it never waits on an approval prompt. Order matters only for the c_mem* trio. Expectations are first-draft: run once, review failures that look like a wrong expectation rather than a wrong answer, and fix the case.
